name: Perversity
overview: Scripture reveals perversity as willful sin and rebellion against God's truth, exemplified by prohibited behaviors such as those condemned in Leviticus 18:22. The Bible warns that deliberate sin after knowing the truth leaves no further sacrifice for forgiveness (Hebrews 10:26), highlighting the seriousness of such choices. Human temptation arises from inward lusts (James 1:14), and even the tongue can offend, demonstrating the pervasive nature of sin in all aspects of life (James 3:2). Yet, salvation is offered through faith in Jesus Christ, providing hope and restoration to those who believe (Acts 16:31).
